heightEncoding.note: The six-bit field spans -2.0 m to 10.4 m. The barrens basin is authored inside that band on purpose, so only 9.8% of walkable cells saturate - those are the mountain flanks and the massif. Elsewhere the encoded height is the real surface height, and the server has genuine elevation rather than a flat plateau.

notes: Every terrain sub-mesh is named Terrain_<class>; every built walkable surface is named Walk_<...>. The client turns both into the navigation collision layer the grounding ray tests.
Crystal bridge decks are walk surfaces, so a downward grounding ray under one resolves onto the deck above; the gully or river beneath them is not separately walkable.
